findings.body: For a blocking title beginning with whitespace, such as ` Simpler: combine the save paths`, recording chooses `bug` because the original title does not start with `Simpler`. Dismissal first collapses whitespace, then chooses `simplify`, so this lookup misses the recorded key and leaves the dismissed entry open. Review titles retain their whitespace in `src/forge/review.py:563`. Derive the kind consistently in both paths so a successful dismissal closes its entry.
findings.title: Use the same kind when recording and dismissing a finding
